skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develops the ability to explain the basics of data analysis, identify the 'IMPACT' cycle in the data analysis process, and the necessary data analysis skills for accountants.
Evaluates various types of data, extracts, transforms, loads, and stores data, and practices data processing with software.
Applies data analysis techniques and processes the results of data analysis in accounting.
Illustrates data visually through diagrams, visual images, and reports the results of data analysis.
Applies dynamic data analysis in a modern accounting environment.
Develops skills in using office software.
Develops skills in using accounting software and data analysis software in accounting.
Develops systematic thinking skills from data analysis.
Develops data analysis skills in accounting.
Develops the ability to interpret data analysis results and make recommendations based on those results.
Develops skills in communicating and writing reports on data analysis in accounting.
Develops skills in presenting data analysis content in accounting.
Organizes independent work, demonstrates personal responsibility, and responsibility towards the work team.
